//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the CHECKBOX-LIST CONTAINER — the `.pa-checkbox-list` block (keen `PureAdmin.Components.CheckboxList.checkbox_list/1`, svelte `display/CheckboxList.svelte`). SCOPE = CONTAINER ONLY. BOTH wrappers render rows from a SLOT of item components (keen `checkbox_list_item/1`, svelte `CheckboxListItem.svelte`), and BOTH fidelity dumpers feed a slot only PLAIN ESCAPED TEXT (svelte `textSnippet`, keen `text_slot`) — real `pa-checkbox-list__item` children can't flow through the slot, exactly as in the `list` container precedent. So this fixture proves ONLY what the <ul> container emits: its tag, its pa-checkbox-list class (+ the 7 layout/variant modifiers), the body slot, and class passthrough. Per-ROW structure (pa-checkbox-list__item / __label / __checkbox / __text / __description / __actions and the __item--selected/--disabled/--locked state modifiers) is PROSE-deferred below. NOTE both wrappers DO ship a standalone item component — but neither dumper REGISTERS a `checkbox-list-item` fragment (and this session must not edit the dumpers), so a verified `{fixture:...}` ref would hard-fail DEFER?; prose is the honest form here (the list/timeline container-only precedent). SIBLING blocks `pa-checkbox` (the custom tri-state checkbox from _checkboxes-radios.scss) and `pa-checkbox-group` (form-layout container) are DIFFERENT components and OUT OF SCOPE — there is no `pa-checkbox-box` block in the compiled CSS (keen's `checkbox_box/1` renders a `pa-checkbox`, not its own block).

propsVocabulary.body: the list's row area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real pa-checkbox-list__item children are the prose-deferred sub-slice)
propsVocabulary.variant: list style variant → one pa-checkbox-list--* modifier (compact | bordered | striped). Both wrappers expose this as `variant`.
propsVocabulary.layout: list layout → one pa-checkbox-list--* modifier (inline | grid | 2col | 3col). Both wrappers expose this as `layout`. Orthogonal to variant — the two can compose, but each wrapper takes at most one value per axis.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only. The container is always a <ul class="pa-checkbox-list ..."> in BOTH wrappers (svelte template is a fixed <ul>, keen renders a literal <ul> — neither offers an `as`/tag choice, so the <ul> is unambiguous). The body slot is a plain text token so the diff checks the container's tag + class + nesting, not rich row content. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away; goldens are written for readability.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The .pa-checkbox-list BLOCK has SEVEN flat modifiers — split here across the two wrapper API axes (variant: compact/bordered/striped; layout: inline/grid/2col/3col) that BOTH wrappers expose, so every pa-checkbox-list--* is claimed by a feature's `produces`. The __element and __item--state classes are per-ROW markup, prose-deferred below (see top note).

body.note: structural — the container's inner content; row structure is the deferred sub-slice

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: Per-ROW element + item-state classes of the pa-checkbox-list block — NOT container markup. Both wrappers build them from a slot of standalone item components (keen checkbox_list_item/1, svelte CheckboxListItem.svelte), which the container-only slot (plain text in both dumpers) can't carry. PROSE deferral (not a verified {fixture:...} ref) because neither dumper registers a `checkbox-list-item` fragment this session and the dumpers must not be edited. Verified instead in each wrapper's own component tests.
deferred.pa-checkbox-list__item: per-row — built by the item component (checkbox_list_item/1 / CheckboxListItem), not the container slot
deferred.pa-checkbox-list__item--selected: per-row state modifier — item component only (keen state="selected", svelte isSelected)
deferred.pa-checkbox-list__item--disabled: per-row state modifier — item component only (state="disabled")
deferred.pa-checkbox-list__item--locked: per-row state modifier — item component only (state="locked")
deferred.pa-checkbox-list__label: per-row — the clickable <label> emitted by the item component
deferred.pa-checkbox-list__checkbox: per-row — LEGACY native-input helper class; neither wrapper emits it (both nest the custom pa-checkbox via checkbox_box/CheckboxBox), so it is unexercised core legacy tolerance
deferred.pa-checkbox-list__text: per-row — title wrapper emitted by the item component
deferred.pa-checkbox-list__description: per-row — muted caption emitted by the item component when a description is supplied
deferred.pa-checkbox-list__actions: per-row — absolutely-positioned button group emitted by the item component's actions slot
